page.overview:
Who is Kibitz?

Kibitz is a male unicorn pony and Princess Celestia's royal scheduling advisor in, wherein he performs his normal duties for Princess Luna instead of her older sister — part of My Little Pony.

He also appears throughout Reflections, again acting as an aide to the two royal sisters. Kibitz is a gray-haired unicorn pony with bushy eyebrows and a long mustache. He keeps his mane and tail drawn back and tied in ponytails.

Kibitz always appears wearing a dark red coat, a gray cravat, and an undersized pair of glasses. His cutie mark is a pocket watch or a stopwatch. Kibitz's alternate-universe counterpart appears in this story.

He wears a black coat with a high collar, a black cape, and a black bow tie. This Kibitz bears fangs, hairy ears, and a darker coloration but lacks a horn.
